$comment: Tactical-map corridor routing (display only). Each edge is drawn octilinearly (0/45/90 degrees) from a to b: 's' = straight run first, then the 45-degree leg into b; 'd' = 45-degree leg first; 'm' = straight / diagonal / straight with the diagonal centred; an array = explicit waypoints. Edges not listed use 's'. Read by client/src/map/schematic.ts and scripts/cameras/validate-network.mjs.
